title: Find email by date and filter
problem: A long mailbox had no way to find a day’s mail or narrow the list.
now: Filters for date (one day or a range), address, read, attachments, person, customers and orders; numbered pages with a page size.
steps: Open Inbox › Email and press the filter button.
Choose Date › On a date… and pick a day.
Change to 10 a page and go to page 2.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
